name: a line row axis drops a player who has no ladder that week (executed-result parity)
description: POPULATION, not values -- the one place a line-axis view differs from the same view WITHOUT the axis. The rung CTE is the row source and it is joined INNER, so a player-week with no selection under the requested market has no rung and therefore contributes NO ROW AT ALL. Without the axis the same request renders every MLB player-week with a blank cell. Seed TWO players on one 2023 REG week 1 game: one carries a two-rung FanDuel GAME_ALT_PASSING_YARDS ladder, the other carries no betting market whatsoever. Only the laddered player appears, and he appears once per rung. This is the axis DEFINITION rather than a gap -- a row means "the book posted this line", so a rung that does not exist cannot be a row, and left-joining a synthesised rung domain instead was rejected on the task as null-dominated. It is pinned because it is invisible from the values alone: a future change of this join to LEFT would render the unladdered player as a blank row and read like an improvement while silently changing what a row MEANS. The oracle compares pid alongside the line so a swap of which player survived cannot pass.
expected_query:
with "base_years" as (SELECT unnest(ARRAY[2023]) as year), "player_years" as (SELECT DISTINCT player.pid, base_years.year FROM player CROSS JOIN base_years WHERE player.primary_position IN ('MLB')), "player_years_weeks" as (SELECT player_years.pid, nfl_year_week_timestamp.year, nfl_year_week_timestamp.week FROM player_years INNER JOIN nfl_year_week_timestamp ON player_years.year = nfl_year_week_timestamp.year WHERE nfl_year_week_timestamp.year = 2023 AND nfl_year_week_timestamp.week IN (1)), "player_years_weeks_lines" as (select distinct "pms"."selection_pid" as "pid", "nfl_games"."season_year" as "year", "nfl_games"."week" as "week", "pms"."selection_metric_line" as "selection_metric_line" from "prop_markets_index" as "m" inner join "nfl_games" on "nfl_games"."esbid" = "m"."esbid" and "nfl_games"."season_year" = "m"."season_year" inner join "prop_market_selections_index" as "pms" on "pms"."source_id" = "m"."source_id" and "pms"."source_market_id" = "m"."source_market_id" and "pms"."time_type" = "m"."time_type" where "pms"."selection_metric_line" is not null and "nfl_games"."season_year" in (2023) and "m"."season_year" in (2023) and "nfl_games"."week" in (1) and (("m"."market_type" in ('GAME_ALT_PASSING_YARDS') and "m"."source_id" in ('FANDUEL') and "m"."time_type" in ('CLOSE') and "pms"."selection_type" in ('OVER')))), "t95cb9309bbc095bef3ac655cb0ab32bb_markets" as (select "source_id", "source_market_id", "time_type", "prop_markets_index"."esbid", "nfl_games"."season_year" as "year", "nfl_games"."week" as "week" from "prop_markets_index" inner join "nfl_games" on "nfl_games"."esbid" = "prop_markets_index"."esbid" and "nfl_games"."season_year" = "prop_markets_index"."season_year" and nfl_games.nfl_week_id in ('2023_REG_WEEK_1') where "market_type" = 'GAME_ALT_PASSING_YARDS' and "time_type" = 'CLOSE' and "prop_markets_index"."season_year" in (2023) and "source_id" = 'FANDUEL'), "t95cb9309bbc095bef3ac655cb0ab32bb" as (select pms.selection_pid, pms.selection_metric_line, "m"."year", "m"."week" from "t95cb9309bbc095bef3ac655cb0ab32bb_markets" as "m" inner join "prop_market_selections_index" as "pms" on "pms"."source_id" = "m"."source_id" and "pms"."source_market_id" = "m"."source_market_id" and "pms"."time_type" = "m"."time_type" where "pms"."selection_type" in ('OVER')), "player_participation_weeks" as (SELECT pid, year, week, bool_or(is_active) AS is_active
          FROM (SELECT pgl.pid, 2023::int AS year, g.week, pgl.is_active
       FROM player_gamelogs_year_2023 pgl
       INNER JOIN nfl_games g ON g.esbid = pgl.esbid
       WHERE g.season_type = 'REG' AND g.season_year = 2023) src
          GROUP BY pid, year, week), "player_years_teams" as (SELECT pid, year, array_agg(DISTINCT team_code) AS teams
          FROM (SELECT pgl.pid, 2023::int AS year, pgl.nfl_team AS team_code
       FROM player_gamelogs_year_2023 pgl
       INNER JOIN nfl_games g ON g.esbid = pgl.esbid
       WHERE g.season_type = 'REG' AND g.season_year = 2023) src
          GROUP BY pid, year), "team_weeks_played" as (select distinct "team", "year", "week" from ((select "home_nfl_team" as "team", "season_year" as "year", "week" from "nfl_games" where "nfl_games"."nfl_week_id" in ('2023_REG_WEEK_1') and "nfl_games"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_games"."season_year" in (2023)) union all (select "away_nfl_team" as "team", "season_year" as "year", "week" from "nfl_games" where "nfl_games"."nfl_week_id" in ('2023_REG_WEEK_1') and "nfl_games"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_games"."season_year" in (2023))) as "g") select "player"."pid", player.first_name, player.last_name, "t95cb9309bbc095bef3ac655cb0ab32bb"."selection_metric_line" AS "game_prop_line_betting_market_0", "player_years_weeks"."year", "player_years_weeks"."week", CASE
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.is_active THEN 'active'
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.pid IS NULL
          AND player_years_teams.teams IS NOT NULL
          AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM team_weeks_played
            WHERE team_weeks_played.year = player_years_weeks.year
              AND team_weeks_played.week = player_years_weeks.week
              AND team_weeks_played.team = ANY(player_years_teams.teams)
          )
       THEN 'bye'
     ELSE NULL
   END AS participation_status, "player"."primary_position" from "player" inner join "player_years_weeks" on "player_years_weeks"."pid" = "player"."pid" inner join "player_years_weeks_lines" on "player_years_weeks_lines"."pid" = "player"."pid" and "player_years_weeks_lines"."year" = "player_years_weeks"."year" and "player_years_weeks_lines"."week" = "player_years_weeks"."week" left join "t95cb9309bbc095bef3ac655cb0ab32bb" on "t95cb9309bbc095bef3ac655cb0ab32bb"."selection_pid" = "player"."pid" and t95cb9309bbc095bef3ac655cb0ab32bb.year = player_years_weeks.year and t95cb9309bbc095bef3ac655cb0ab32bb.week = player_years_weeks.week and "t95cb9309bbc095bef3ac655cb0ab32bb"."selection_metric_line" = player_years_weeks_lines.selection_metric_line left join "player_participation_weeks" on "player_participation_weeks"."pid" = "player"."pid" and "player_participation_weeks"."year" = "player_years_weeks"."year" and "player_participation_weeks"."week" = "player_years_weeks"."week" left join "player_years_teams" on "player_years_teams"."pid" = "player"."pid" and "player_years_teams"."year" = "player_years_weeks"."year" where player.primary_position IN ('MLB') group by player.first_name, player.last_name, "t95cb9309bbc095bef3ac655cb0ab32bb"."selection_metric_line", "player_years_weeks"."year", "player_years_weeks"."week", CASE
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.is_active THEN 'active'
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.pid IS NULL
          AND player_years_teams.teams IS NOT NULL
          AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM team_weeks_played
            WHERE team_weeks_played.year = player_years_weeks.year
              AND team_weeks_played.week = player_years_weeks.week
              AND team_weeks_played.team = ANY(player_years_teams.teams)
          )
       THEN 'bye'
     ELSE NULL
   END, "player"."pid", "player"."last_name", "player"."first_name", "player"."primary_position" order by "player"."pid" asc limit 500
